Common Questions

Do I need an appointment?

Appointments are recommended so we can give your vehicle full attention, but call us if you need urgent help.

How do I get an estimate for body damage?

Use the Request an Estimate form with clear photos from several angles, or stop by the shop.

Do you work on all makes and models?

We service most domestic and import vehicles. Call us to confirm for your car.

Can you handle both mechanical and body repair?

Yes. Auto repair and body & collision work are both done at our Devon Ave location.

How long will my repair take?

It depends on the work and parts. We will give you a timeline after inspecting your vehicle.
